title: Tiny11 Standard custom ISO build configuration
description: Change iso_url to start a custom-source Standard build. The JSON file is tracked by Git, so only use a URL safe for repository history.

$schema.description: Local schema reference for editor validation and completion.

iso_url.title: Direct Windows ISO URL
iso_url.description: Public HTTPS direct-download link whose path ends in .iso. This value is committed to Git history; never put a private or expiring token here.

windows_version.title: Windows release label
windows_version.description: Usually leave as auto; the workflow infers a label from the URL filename and otherwise uses Custom.

windows_build.title: Fallback build number
windows_build.description: Optional fallback used only when the build number cannot be read from the ISO metadata.

image_edition.title: Windows edition
image_edition.description: The requested edition is selected by its actual image name when image_index is 0.

image_index.title: Source image index
image_index.description: Use 0 to select image_edition by actual image name; otherwise supply an index verified from this ISO.

skip_cleanup.title: Skip cleanup
skip_cleanup.description: Debug only; normal cleanup is recommended.
